intent: Make the 'flow' (a cursor-spine DAG of timestamped nodes the agent visits, tracked across compaction) a first-class DETERMINISTIC concept inside the harness CLI (a `harness flow` verb family) — deterministic MECHANICS (mutation/history/render), not automated routing. Shared-core schema + per-flow custom overlays; deterministic render; embedded event log + per-node timestamped comments (datetime queryable). Two built-in schemas: the-flow (skill-shipped) + harness-loop (CLI-bundled). the-flow consumes the CLI (capability/version-floor required, no adoption needed); clean break (old flows error, no back-compat). Onboarding/adopt + flow agent deferred. Full, CS-4, 3 phases. Re-planned v1.1.0 + amended v1.2.0 + validated. PHASE 1 COMPLETE 16/16 on branch 024-first-class-flow-system — all committed + green (full suite 639->719); the harness flow engine (schema+overlay, atomic state I/O, mutations+insert-node, event log+comments+datetime, E300-E309, gen:flows, 2 contract snapshots, E308/E306) stands up. code-review-companion reviewed all 4 commit boundaries (3 findings: 1 MEDIUM + 2 HIGH, all addressed). Renderer = Phase 2; the-flow migration = Phase 3. NEXT = Phase 2 tasks (render + CI + docs); recommend /compact first.
